result.topic_en: Gauss works out a formula for the difference φ(a,b) − φ(b,a) in terms of the parities and quotients of a chain of numbers a, b, c, … (apparently successive remainders), checks it on a numerical example (379, 206, 173, 33, 8, 1), and states functional properties of an auxiliary function ψ defined by φ(a,b) = (ab − 2a + 2)/8 + ψ(a,b).
